name: Forge-Master Golem

passive.name: Overheat
passive.text: Every action fills its Heat bar. Fire hits fill it faster; ice hits and water skills drain it. When the bar is full it must Vent: it loses its next turn and has 0 Armor until then. When it dies, the same cell on your side and the cells around it burn for 4 turns.
